# Logistic Regression

```{r, warning = FALSE}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
threshold_grid <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length.out = 51)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(threshold in threshold_grid){
      print("threshold")
      print(threshold)
      
      for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
        CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
        train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
        train_index <- c(1:n) 
        train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
        test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
        test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
        Model <- glm(target ~ ., data = data, subset = train_index, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
        
        
        # Prediction이 확률로 나오는 경우
        prob_pred <- predict(Model, newdata = test, type = "response")
        pred <- rep(0, test_rowNum)
        pred[prob_pred > threshold] <- 1
        
        # Update Scores
        Accuracy_LR[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_LR[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
        FPR_LR[[seed]] <- c(FPR_LR[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
        FNR_LR[[seed]] <- c(FNR_LR[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
        F1_LR[[seed]] <- c(F1_LR[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))
      }
      
  }
}
```

## CV meaning process

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_LR <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(threshold_grid)){
      CVAccuracy_LR[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_LR[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_LR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFPR_LR[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_LR[[seed]], mean(FPR_LR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFNR_LR[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_LR[[seed]], mean(FNR_LR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVF1_LR[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_LR[[seed]], mean(F1_LR[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
  }
}
```

## Accuracy

```{r}
LR_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(CVAccuracy_LR)
colnames(LR_Accuracy) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
LR_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(LR_Accuracy)))

LR_Accuracy
```


```{r}
LR_Accuracy <- LR_Accuracy%>%
  gather("V1","V2","V3","V4","V5","V6","V7","V8","V9","V10","V11","V12","V13","V14","V15","V16","V17","V18","V19","V20", "V21", "V22","V23","V24","V25","V26","V27", "V28", "V29", "V30","V31","V32","V33","V34","V35","V36","V37","V38","V39","V40","V41","V42","V43","V44","V45","V46","V47","V48","V49","V50","V51", key = "threshold", value = "Accuracy")


LR_Accuracy_mean <- LR_Accuracy%>%
  group_by(threshold)%>%
  summarise(Accuracy_mean = mean(Accuracy)) 

LR_Accuracy_mean%>%
  arrange(desc(Accuracy_mean))%>%
  head(10)
```

```{r}
ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(data = LR_Accuracy%>%
  filter(threshold %in% c("V22","V23","V24","V25","V26","V27","V28","V29","V30","V31")), aes(x = Accuracy, y = threshold, color = threshold))+
  geom_point(data = LR_Accuracy_mean%>%
               filter(threshold %in% c("V22","V23","V24","V25","V26","V27","V28","V29","V30","V31")), aes(x = Accuracy_mean, y = threshold))
```


## F1 score

```{r}
LR_F1 <- as.data.frame(CVF1_LR)
colnames(LR_F1) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
LR_F1 <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(LR_F1)))

LR_F1
```

```{r}
LR_F1 <- LR_F1%>%
  gather("V1","V2","V3","V4","V5","V6","V7","V8","V9","V10","V11","V12","V13","V14","V15","V16","V17","V18","V19","V20", "V21", "V22","V23","V24","V25","V26","V27", "V28", "V29", "V30","V31","V32","V33","V34","V35","V36","V37","V38","V39","V40","V41","V42","V43","V44","V45","V46","V47","V48","V49","V50","V51", key = "threshold", value = "F1")


LR_F1_mean <- LR_F1%>%

```

```{r}
ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(data = LR_F1%>%
  filter(threshold %in% c("V13","V14","V15","V16","V17","V18","V19","V20","V21","V22")), aes(x = F1, y = threshold, color = threshold))+

               filter(threshold %in% c("V13","V14","V15","V16","V17","V18","V19","V20","V21","V22")), aes(x = F1_mean, y = threshold))
```
